caption: A 3980-byte payload is split into data blocks of 1480, 1480 and 1020 bytes. The offsets jump by 185 and 370 because they count 8-byte units, and the last fragment clears MF.

spec.title: Fragments for MTU 1500
spec.aria: A 3980-byte payload is cut into data sizes 1480, 1480 and 1020 bytes; offsets are 0, 185 and 370 in 8-byte units, with MF flags 1, 1, 0.
